nodes.label: Assert the Result, Not the Registration Call
nodes.rationale: WordPress is fully loaded and init already fired, so the modules already ran. A second do_action('init') registers things twice.
nodes.norm_label: assert the result, not the registration call

nodes.label: Skip, Do Not Fail, Without the Build Directory
nodes.norm_label: skip, do not fail, without the build directory

nodes.label: Clean Up Created Data
nodes.rationale: The database survives inside one run of the suite, so tests must stay independent.

nodes.label: WordPress Dist Tag Version Constraints (wp-6.9)
nodes.rationale: Dist tags keep the npm dependencies compatible with the minimum WordPress version that composer.json supports.

nodes.label: units.rem() and units.em() Mixins (_units.scss)
nodes.rationale: Relative units scale with the settings of the user, px does not.

nodes.label: index.scss as Package Public API (@forward, no @import)
nodes.norm_label: index.scss as package public api (@forward, no @import)

nodes.label: No get Prefix for Methods and Functions
nodes.norm_label: no get prefix for methods and functions

nodes.label: Hook Naming Pattern {project-name}.{package}.{event-name}
nodes.rationale: Hook names must be descriptive: past tense after an operation, present tense before or during it, dashes and no underscores.

nodes.label: Commit Types (feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, perf, style, build, ci, chore, revert)
nodes.rationale: feat and fix describe the plugin, not the repository. A new skill or rule in .claude/ is docs.
nodes.norm_label: commit types (feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, perf, style, build, ci, chore, revert)

nodes.label: Commit Scopes (server, client, package, tests, e2e, deps, claude, wp-env, docs)
nodes.rationale: A scope must name a directory or a file that exists.
nodes.norm_label: commit scopes (server, client, package, tests, e2e, deps, claude, wp-env, docs)

nodes.label: Title 50 Characters, Body 72 Characters, Body Explains Why
nodes.rationale: The diff already shows what changed, so the body explains why.
nodes.norm_label: title 50 characters, body 72 characters, body explains why

nodes.label: Breaking Change Marker (! and BREAKING CHANGE footer)
nodes.norm_label: breaking change marker (! and breaking change footer)

nodes.label: Validate Server Data in the init Callback
nodes.rationale: A store validates config, state and context before it binds anything. init catches the error and calls reportError, because an error that leaves init can stop the effects of other stores on the page.
nodes.norm_label: validate server data in the init callback

nodes.label: No Fallback Values for Server Data
nodes.rationale: A fallback hides a bug of the server, so .default() and .catch() are forbidden on schemas of server data.
nodes.norm_label: no fallback values for server data

nodes.label: Server Data Helpers (initializeServerConfig, initializeServerState, initializeServerContext)
nodes.rationale: The helpers write into the proxy with Object.assign, because a reassignment does not change a proxy.

nodes.label: zod.ts Helper (only import of z, loads the English locale)
nodes.rationale: Only zod.ts loads the English locale. Without it, every error says only Invalid input.
nodes.norm_label: zod.ts helper (only import of z, loads the english locale)

nodes.label: Types Inferred from Schemas (types.ts, z.infer)
nodes.source_location: 3) Take the types from the schemas

nodes.label: Validation Sequence: Config, State, Context
nodes.rationale: Config and state are global, so only the first init checks them. The config is cached last, so a failed state check repeats. The context belongs to each element, so each init checks it.

nodes.label: getServerContext Returns the Merged Context (inherited keys)
nodes.norm_label: getservercontext returns the merged context (inherited keys)

nodes.label: z.strictObject Rule
nodes.rationale: An unknown key fails the parse, so a change on the server that the client does not know about shows at once.

nodes.label: Limit URL Schemes (z.url with protocol)
nodes.rationale: A plain z.url() accepts javascript:.

nodes.label: Router Guardrails (Composer and pnpm, never npm or npx)
nodes.norm_label: router guardrails (composer and pnpm, never npm or npx)

nodes.label: No Blocks: the Store Enhances Footer Markup
nodes.rationale: The project has no blocks, so do not scaffold with @wordpress/create-block. A store lives in its own directory under sources/client/ with an index.module.ts entry point, registered with wp_register_script_module().
nodes.norm_label: no blocks: the store enhances footer markup

nodes.label: Hydration Mismatch and Layout Shift Failure Modes
nodes.norm_label: hydration mismatch and layout shift failure modes

nodes.label: getServerState and getServerContext Reset Between Page Transitions
nodes.norm_label: getserverstate and getservercontext reset between page transitions

nodes.label: data-wp-* Directives (interactive, context, on, on-async, bind, class)
nodes.norm_label: data-wp-* directives (interactive, context, on, on-async, bind, class)

nodes.label: Unique Directive IDs (--- separator)
nodes.rationale: HTML does not allow duplicate attributes, so each plugin adds a unique ID after ---.

nodes.label: data-wp-ignore Deprecated
nodes.rationale: It broke context inheritance and client-side navigation.

nodes.label: Server-Side Rendering for Interactivity API
nodes.rationale: Pre-rendered HTML gives a faster initial render, no layout shift, SEO benefits and graceful degradation.

nodes.label: wp_interactivity_process_directives()
nodes.rationale: Call it only once, at the outermost template level.

nodes.label: Derived State on the Server (static and closures)
nodes.rationale: Derived state that affects the initial HTML must exist in PHP, and must match the JavaScript logic, to avoid a layout shift.
nodes.norm_label: derived state on the server (static and closures)

nodes.label: Prefer Correct Types over Ignored Errors
nodes.norm_label: prefer correct types over ignored errors

nodes.label: PHPStan Baseline Workflow
nodes.rationale: A baseline is a migration tool for legacy code, not a place for new errors.

nodes.label: WordPress Stub Packages (szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress, php-stubs/wordpress-stubs)
nodes.rationale: Stubs give real type checks without a full WordPress checkout, instead of blanket ignores.

nodes.label: Targeted ignoreErrors Patterns
nodes.rationale: A narrow pattern for a vendor prefix does not hide unrelated issues.

nodes.label: REST Request Typing (WP_REST_Request<array{...}>)
nodes.rationale: PHPStan cannot infer valid request parameters from REST API schemas.

nodes.label: Validated Docblocks for apply_filters() and do_action()
nodes.rationale: The type of the first @param is definitive, so a wrong type from a third party needs no defensive code.
nodes.norm_label: validated docblocks for apply_filters() and do_action()

nodes.label: Array and Object Shapes (query results, Action Scheduler args)
nodes.norm_label: array and object shapes (query results, action scheduler args)

nodes.label: WP Performance Skill (backend-only)
nodes.rationale: Assumes the agent cannot use a browser UI, so it prefers WP-CLI, logs and HTTP requests.

nodes.label: Guardrail: Measure First, Avoid Risky Operations
nodes.rationale: Capture a baseline on a reproducible target before any change; confirm that write operations are permitted.
nodes.norm_label: guardrail: measure first, avoid risky operations

nodes.label: perf_inspect.mjs Report Script
nodes.rationale: Gives a deterministic backend-only report: WP-CLI availability, core version, wp doctor/profile availability, autoload size, object-cache drop-in.

nodes.label: Fix by Dominant Bottleneck Category
nodes.rationale: Use the profile output to pick one primary bottleneck category, then apply the fix patterns of that category.

nodes.label: Verify: Repeat the Same Measurement
nodes.rationale: Re-run the same profile/doctor/REST request to confirm the delta; a cache flush must be the last resort.

nodes.label: WordPress 6.9 Frontend Performance Improvements
nodes.rationale: On-demand CSS for classic themes cuts the CSS payload by 30-65%; block themes can load with zero render-blocking CSS, which improves LCP.

nodes.label: Production Escalation Rules
nodes.rationale: Without explicit approval in production: no plugin installs, no SAVEQUERIES, no load tests, no cache flushes during traffic.

nodes.label: Autoload Bloat
nodes.rationale: Autoloaded options load on every request, so a large autoload payload hurts performance on the whole site.

nodes.label: Fix Pattern: Stop Autoloading Large Blobs
nodes.rationale: Store large data in options with autoload=off, or move computed data to transients or the object cache.
nodes.norm_label: fix pattern: stop autoloading large blobs

nodes.label: Cron Fix Patterns (de-duplicate, idempotent, off-request)
nodes.rationale: Cron that runs on page load can hurt TTFB; keep tasks short and idempotent and move heavy work off-request.

nodes.label: N+1 Query Pattern
nodes.rationale: Batch queries and prime caches to avoid lookups per row.

nodes.label: Remote Request Fix Patterns (timeouts, cache, batch, async)
nodes.rationale: Do not call remote APIs on every page load; add fail-fast timeouts and move heavy remote work to cron or a queue.
nodes.norm_label: remote request fix patterns (timeouts, cache, batch, async)

nodes.label: Baseline First, Fixed Scenario, Multiple Samples
nodes.rationale: Keep the scenario fixed and prefer medians of multiple samples over single runs, because single runs are noisy.
nodes.norm_label: baseline first, fixed scenario, multiple samples

nodes.label: APM and Profilers (New Relic, Datadog, Blackfire, Tideways, XHProf, Xdebug)
nodes.norm_label: apm and profilers (new relic, datadog, blackfire, tideways, xhprof, xdebug)

nodes.label: Persistent Object Cache Drop-in (object-cache.php)
nodes.rationale: The default object cache lives in memory for one request only; a drop-in keeps the cache across requests.

nodes.label: Guardrail: wp cache flush
nodes.rationale: wp cache flush can affect all sites of a multisite and cause load spikes.

nodes.label: Fix Pattern: Cache with Explicit Invalidation
nodes.rationale: Avoid unbounded caches: set expirations or implement invalidation hooks.
nodes.norm_label: fix pattern: cache with explicit invalidation

nodes.label: Query Monitor Plugin
nodes.rationale: Query Monitor adds overhead; do not enable it in production without approval.

nodes.label: Query Monitor via REST Headers (x-qm-*) and qm Envelope
nodes.rationale: Lets a backend-only agent read Query Monitor data from authenticated REST responses without a browser.
nodes.norm_label: query monitor via rest headers (x-qm-*) and qm envelope

nodes.label: Performance Lab Plugin
nodes.rationale: Do not enable experimental modules in production without approval.

nodes.label: wp doctor Command
nodes.rationale: Quick production readiness checks; run it before deep profiling because it catches common production mistakes.

nodes.label: constant-savequeries-falsy / constant-wp-debug-falsy Checks
nodes.rationale: SAVEQUERIES and WP_DEBUG cost performance in production.

nodes.label: wp profile Command
nodes.rationale: Gives actionable profiling without a browser.

nodes.label: Plugin Entry Points (bootstrap, sources/package.php, Module.php)
nodes.rationale: The bootstrap holds the plugin header; sources/package.php builds the package; each module starts at sources/server/<Name>/Module.php.

nodes.label: Security Baseline (always)
nodes.rationale: Sanitize input early, escape output late, pair nonces with capability checks, use $wpdb->prepare() for SQL.

nodes.label: Data Storage, Cron and Upgrades Reference
nodes.norm_label: data storage, cron and upgrades reference

nodes.label: Options API vs Custom Tables
nodes.rationale: Prefer the Options API for small config; use custom tables only when needed, with a stored schema version and upgrade paths.

nodes.label: Idempotent Cron Tasks with Manual Trigger
nodes.rationale: Cron tasks can run late or multiple times, so they must be idempotent; a manual trigger helps debugging.
nodes.norm_label: idempotent cron tasks with manual trigger

nodes.label: $wpdb->prepare() and the %i Identifier Placeholder
nodes.rationale: The %i placeholder exists only in recent WordPress versions; check the target version before use.

nodes.label: register_activation_hook / register_deactivation_hook
nodes.rationale: These hooks must be registered at top-level, not inside other hooks; activation runs in a special context.

nodes.label: Flush Rewrite Rules Only After Registration
nodes.rationale: Register the rules first, often through a function shared by init and activation, then flush.
nodes.norm_label: flush rewrite rules only after registration

nodes.label: Uninstall (uninstall.php / register_uninstall_hook)
nodes.rationale: Check WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN before destructive cleanup.

nodes.label: Nonces Plus Capability Checks
nodes.rationale: Nonces prevent CSRF but do not authorize; always pair them with current_user_can().

nodes.label: Sanitize on Input, Escape on Output
nodes.rationale: Golden rule: validate/sanitize on input and escape on output; read explicit keys of $_POST/$_GET and use wp_unslash().
nodes.norm_label: sanitize on input, escape on output

nodes.label: Prepared Statements for SQL
nodes.rationale: Do not interpolate user input into queries.

nodes.label: Predictable Init (minimal boot file, hook loader, admin-only code)
nodes.rationale: Avoid heavy side effects at file load time; keep admin-only code behind admin hooks to reduce frontend overhead.
nodes.norm_label: predictable init (minimal boot file, hook loader, admin-only code)

nodes.label: Choose the Approach: wp/v2 Exposure vs Custom Endpoints
nodes.rationale: Use show_in_rest to expose a CPT/taxonomy in wp/v2; use register_rest_route with a controller class for custom endpoints. A new endpoint goes in its own module under sources/server/.
nodes.norm_label: choose the approach: wp/v2 exposure vs custom endpoints

nodes.label: REST Failure Modes (404, 401/403, _doing_it_wrong, invalid params, missing fields)
nodes.norm_label: rest failure modes (404, 401/403, _doing_it_wrong, invalid params, missing fields)

nodes.label: Cookie Authentication + X-WP-Nonce (wp_rest)
nodes.rationale: If the nonce is missing, WordPress treats the request as unauthenticated even if cookies exist.

nodes.label: Application Passwords
nodes.rationale: Available from WordPress 5.6; use HTTPS + Basic Auth; recommended over the legacy Basic Auth plugin.

nodes.label: Auth Plugins (OAuth 1.0a, JWT)
nodes.rationale: Use only if required.

nodes.label: register_post_type_args / register_taxonomy_args Filters
nodes.rationale: Enable show_in_rest for types that you do not control.

nodes.label: REST Discovery and Global Parameters Reference
nodes.norm_label: rest discovery and global parameters reference

nodes.label: REST Pagination (page, per_page, X-WP-Total, X-WP-TotalPages)
nodes.rationale: per_page is capped at 100.

nodes.label: Do Not Remove Core Fields
nodes.rationale: A removed or changed core field breaks clients, wp-admin included; add fields or use _fields instead.

nodes.label: register_meta / register_post_meta / register_term_meta
nodes.rationale: For object or array types, show_in_rest.schema must hold a JSON schema.

nodes.label: Raw vs Rendered Content (?context=edit, content.raw)
nodes.rationale: content.rendered includes filter output, for example HTML that a ToC plugin injects.

nodes.label: register_rest_route on rest_api_init
nodes.rationale: A route is the URL pattern; an endpoint is the method plus callback bound to that route.

nodes.label: Route Namespacing (vendor/v1)
nodes.rationale: Do not use the wp/* namespace unless the target is core.

nodes.label: permission_callback (required)
nodes.rationale: A missing permission_callback emits a _doing_it_wrong notice; public endpoints use __return_true, restricted ones use capability checks.

nodes.label: Endpoint args (validate_callback, sanitize_callback)
nodes.rationale: Read params from WP_REST_Request, not from $_GET/$_POST.

nodes.label: Return Values (rest_ensure_response, WP_REST_Response, WP_Error)
nodes.rationale: Do not call wp_send_json() in REST callbacks.

nodes.label: WP_REST_Controller
nodes.rationale: Prefer a controller class for any endpoint that is not trivial.

nodes.label: REST Schema and Argument Validation Reference
nodes.norm_label: rest schema and argument validation reference

nodes.label: JSON Schema in WordPress (draft 4 subset)
nodes.rationale: The schema enables discovery through OPTIONS and validation.

nodes.label: rest_validate_value_from_schema then rest_sanitize_value_from_schema
nodes.rationale: A custom sanitize_callback disables the built-in schema validation; use rest_validate_request_arg to keep it.

nodes.label: Schema Caching on the Controller Instance
nodes.rationale: Cache the generated schema in $this->schema to avoid recomputation.
nodes.norm_label: schema caching on the controller instance

nodes.label: Conventional Commits 1.0.0 format
nodes.rationale: A title of at most 50 characters, fixed types and scopes, imperative lower-case description; the body explains why, not what.

nodes.label: Rule: check server data one time in init, no fallbacks
nodes.rationale: A fallback hides a bug of the server. The error must not leave init, because init runs in an effect and an escaped error can stop the effects of other stores.
nodes.norm_label: rule: check server data one time in init, no fallbacks

nodes.label: zod/mini with export * and the English locale
nodes.rationale: zod/mini keeps the bundle small. The English locale makes an error name the key and the cause. A namespace object export stops the tree shaking, and the bundle then holds all of Zod.
nodes.norm_label: zod/mini with export * and the english locale

nodes.label: Reactive proxy passed as an argument
nodes.rationale: The state and the context are reactive proxies. A new value for a local variable does not change a proxy, so the helper writes into the proxy that the store gives it.
nodes.norm_label: reactive proxy passed as an argument

nodes.label: Decision: delegated listeners, no server pass
nodes.rationale: A server pass earns its cost only when the server knows something the client cannot. URL resolution happens on the endpoint on demand, so directives on each link carried no information. Delegated listeners add no HTML or render cost and cover links added later. Cost: a PHP filter cannot accept or reject a single link.
nodes.norm_label: decision: delegated listeners, no server pass

nodes.label: Konomi Rest library, copied and adapted
nodes.rationale: Route::get() is added; Middlewares\Authentication is dropped because it depends on Konomi\User\User and the endpoint is public; ErrorCatch returns file, line and trace only when WP_DEBUG is true.
nodes.norm_label: konomi rest library, copied and adapted

nodes.label: Spaghetti Dojo project template (Inpsyde Modularity)
nodes.rationale: Every feature class is final readonly, has a static new() factory, a private constructor, and registers hooks only inside init().

nodes.label: REST nonce seeded only for a logged-in user
nodes.rationale: An anonymous page holds no nonce, so a full page cache stays valid.
nodes.norm_label: rest nonce seeded only for a logged-in user

nodes.label: PreviewRepository object cache (group rinkukado)
nodes.rationale: The payload is cached under preview:{id}:{excerptLength} and cleared on save_post, delete_post and clean_post_cache.

nodes.label: Excerpt: manual excerpt, else core fallback
nodes.norm_label: excerpt: manual excerpt, else core fallback

nodes.label: Link policy rules
nodes.rationale: rel=nofollow and rel=sponsored instruct a search engine, not a reader, so they do not reject a link. The host check runs before any request, so an external link costs nothing; an internal non-post URL costs one 404 per href per page.

nodes.label: CSS anchor positioning with a pure fallback
nodes.rationale: computePosition runs only when the browser lacks CSS anchor positioning.
nodes.norm_label: css anchor positioning with a pure fallback

nodes.label: Failure rules: unavailable marker
nodes.rationale: A non-200 response, an invalid payload or a network error marks the href unavailable for the page session. An abort is not a failure and leaves no mark.

nodes.label: Modes rule: two media queries choose three modes
nodes.rationale: An earlier design let the gesture follow the pointer and the layout follow the pointer or the width. A mouse below 782px then met a sheet it could not reach before the 200 ms close delay, and a tap gesture swallows the navigation. A link without a preview is better than a link that does not follow.
nodes.norm_label: modes rule: two media queries choose three modes

nodes.label: Breakpoint 782px ($break-medium) as own SCSS variable
nodes.rationale: The plugin declares the breakpoints it uses as its own SCSS variables, so it does not depend on @wordpress/base-styles for a value it would copy anyway.

nodes.label: Keyboard and assistive technology rules
nodes.rationale: The dialog is not modal. A hover never takes the focus; a tap that opens the sheet moves focus to the dialog, which is why it carries tabindex=-1. Escape returns focus to the link.

nodes.label: Flat thumbnail state keys
nodes.rationale: A flat key holds an empty string when the post has no thumbnail, so no binding reads a property of a null value.

nodes.label: Client split into one concern per file
nodes.rationale: The max-lines and max-lines-per-function ESLint rules forced the split: a single file of this size would not pass them.
nodes.norm_label: client split into one concern per file

nodes.label: Out of scope (admin screen, block, external URL, batch endpoint)
nodes.norm_label: out of scope (admin screen, block, external url, batch endpoint)

nodes.label: Assumption: wp-scripts entry for a script module outside block.json
nodes.rationale: The entry convention with WP_EXPERIMENTAL_MODULES=true is not verified. If there is no convention, the plugin declares an explicit webpack entry.
nodes.norm_label: assumption: wp-scripts entry for a script module outside block.json

nodes.label: Plan 1 global constraints
nodes.rationale: A module is an ExecutableModule unless it must publish services; Rest\Module is the only ServiceModule because the copied library is built that way. Custom hook names follow rinkukado.{package}.{event-name}.

nodes.label: Plan 1 tasks 1-15 (build pipeline to final gate)
nodes.norm_label: plan 1 tasks 1-15 (build pipeline to final gate)

nodes.label: Bundle size measures (zod/mini vs zod)
nodes.rationale: zod/mini is 4.8 kB gzip against 26.2 kB for full zod; the English locale adds 1.2 kB. export { z } gave 93,634 bytes because webpack kept the whole namespace. A conditional locale load was dropped: it saves 1.2 kB and needs a dynamic import split into a chunk.

nodes.label: Why validation runs in init
nodes.rationale: A parse at module load that throws means store() never runs and the directives refer to a store that does not exist: a second failure path. A lazy parse can happen after the binding. init gives one failure path. init runs in a Preact effect with no error boundary, so it catches and calls reportError.

nodes.label: Why the proxy is an argument
nodes.rationale: getContext() and the store state return reactive proxies; a reassignment of a local variable does not change a proxy. The helpers write with Object.assign into the proxy argument, so the write is visible in the store and a test can give a plain object.
nodes.norm_label: why the proxy is an argument

nodes.label: Decision: no .catch() and no .default()
nodes.rationale: Defaults hide server bugs.

nodes.label: Skill project independence
nodes.rationale: The skill contains no project path, plugin name or store name, and uses placeholders, so the same skill can go to other plugins later.

nodes.label: validateServerData caches the config last, on the first init only
nodes.rationale: A later init must not reset the state of an open popover. The config is cached last, so a failed state check repeats at the next init. config() throws when no config was validated.
nodes.norm_label: validateserverdata caches the config last, on the first init only

nodes.label: Tests and checks (Jest, Playwright, build)
nodes.rationale: No Playwright spec for invalid data is added, because the page cannot get invalid config without test code in PHP. The Jest tests cover that path.

nodes.label: Changes to the spec found while planning
nodes.rationale: sanitize takes a Source object because four parameters break max-params 3. zod/mini has no z.ZodError, so the check uses z.core.$ZodError. endpoint uses z.url with an http(s) protocol because a plain z.url() accepts javascript: URLs. Validation runs on the first init only.
nodes.norm_label: changes to the spec found while planning

nodes.label: Plan 2 global constraints (Zod import, ESLint limits)
nodes.norm_label: plan 2 global constraints (zod import, eslint limits)

nodes.label: Plan 2 tasks 1-5 (shared module, schemas, init check, skill, verification)
nodes.norm_label: plan 2 tasks 1-5 (shared module, schemas, init check, skill, verification)

nodes.label: E2E Thumbnail Fixture (solid orange placeholder image)
nodes.norm_label: e2e thumbnail fixture (solid orange placeholder image)

nodes.label: Stop and Confirm After Each Plan Step
nodes.norm_label: stop and confirm after each plan step

nodes.label: Keep Module Documents in Sync With Code
nodes.rationale: A module document can hold rules that the code does not show, so it must change in the same commit as the code.
nodes.norm_label: keep module documents in sync with code

nodes.label: Shared Interactivity Helpers Are a Copy of the Skill Assets
nodes.rationale: sources/client/interactivity/ is a copy of .claude/skills/interactivity-server-data/assets/, so the skill must change first.
nodes.norm_label: shared interactivity helpers are a copy of the skill assets

nodes.label: No Popover on a Narrow Window With a Fine Pointer
nodes.rationale: A sheet at the bottom of a narrow window loses the hover before the pointer reaches it, and a click that opens a sheet swallows the navigation.
nodes.norm_label: no popover on a narrow window with a fine pointer

nodes.label: package() Extension Point
nodes.rationale: package() always returns the same instance, so a third party can add a module before the boot() call at priority 10.

nodes.label: Plugin Filters (No Settings Page)
nodes.rationale: The plugin has no settings page; a site changes the behavior through filters.

nodes.label: Intent Machine (idle, intent, open)
nodes.rationale: The machine does not know the DOM, the network or the clock; each event carries its own time, so the reducer stays pure and testable.

nodes.label: One-Way Data Flow (events, commands, effects)
nodes.rationale: Only driver.send changes the machine, so a transition never skips its commands or the timer that follows.

nodes.label: Server Data Validation (validateServerData)
nodes.rationale: If a parse fails the store binds nothing, so links keep their normal behavior. A later init does not parse again, because a second parse would reset the state of an open popover.

nodes.label: Fetcher Cache per Page Session
nodes.rationale: One request for each href; a settled result is cached, an abort is not, so a later visit can try again.

nodes.label: Navigate on Fetch Failure After a Tap
nodes.rationale: If the fetch fails after a tap, the store navigates, so the link keeps its normal behavior.
nodes.norm_label: navigate on fetch failure after a tap

nodes.label: Preview Payload (id, title, excerpt, permalink, thumbnail)
nodes.norm_label: preview payload (id, title, excerpt, permalink, thumbnail)

nodes.label: Uniform 404 not_found Rejection
nodes.rationale: Every rejection answers 404 not_found; the response never says which check failed.

nodes.label: Filter rinkukado.rest.post-types
nodes.rationale: The default excludes attachment, so a media page shows no preview.

nodes.label: Task 1: Move and Rename the Preview Classes
nodes.norm_label: task 1: move and rename the preview classes

nodes.label: Task 2: Add the Preview Module and Free the Library
nodes.norm_label: task 2: add the preview module and free the library

nodes.label: Risk: Stale Composer Classmap
nodes.rationale: optimize-autoloader is true, so run composer dump-autoload after each move of a PHP file.

nodes.label: Risk: The Route Registers One Time
nodes.rationale: If both modules register it, WordPress merges the handlers without an error.
nodes.norm_label: risk: the route registers one time

nodes.label: Risk: The Config Service Has One Owner
nodes.rationale: Modularity does not let two modules publish the same service id.
nodes.norm_label: risk: the config service has one owner

nodes.label: Risk: The Service Ids Change
nodes.rationale: Third-party code that reads the old ids from package() breaks; the spec accepts this and the plan adds no alias.

nodes.label: Risk: Short Names Controller and Schema Exist Two Times
nodes.rationale: A wrong import makes a preview class implement itself; PHPStan and the unit tests catch it.
nodes.norm_label: risk: short names controller and schema exist two times

nodes.label: PHP Unit Tests (Pest, Brain Monkey)
nodes.rationale: No WordPress, so assert the call; fast and isolates one class.

nodes.label: PHP Integration Tests (Pest, real WordPress)
nodes.rationale: WordPress is already loaded and init already fired, so assert the result and never fire init again.

nodes.label: Client Unit Tests (Jest)
nodes.rationale: Do not test the store here; move logic into a pure function and cover the wiring with an end to end test.

nodes.label: End to End Tests (Playwright, wp-env)
nodes.rationale: Playwright tests the build output, not the sources.

nodes.label: Prefer the Cheapest Layer That Can Fail for the Right Reason
nodes.norm_label: prefer the cheapest layer that can fail for the right reason

nodes.label: Plain Permalinks Cookie for e2e
nodes.rationale: The fixtures filter permalink_structure for one request only, so the stored structure does not change and other specs are not affected.

nodes.label: Known Limit: WP-CLI Deprecation on PHP 8.5
nodes.rationale: The harness treats any stderr output as fatal, so use PHP 8.4.
nodes.norm_label: known limit: wp-cli deprecation on php 8.5

nodes.label: ExecutableModule (default entry point)
nodes.rationale: The default for a module that executes actions or initializes features.

nodes.label: ServiceModule (only when requested)
nodes.rationale: Use only for shared services that need the PSR-11 container. Do not use it unless the user requests it.

nodes.label: Feature Class Pattern (final readonly)
nodes.rationale: Immutable classes give encapsulation. Each feature class handles one concern.

nodes.label: Static new() Factory + Private Constructor
nodes.rationale: The private constructor prevents direct instantiation.

nodes.label: Hook Registration in init()
nodes.rationale: Hooks are never registered in the constructor.

nodes.label: Adapt to Needs (no unused constants or parameters)
nodes.rationale: A simpler approach wins over a forced pattern.
nodes.norm_label: adapt to needs (no unused constants or parameters)

nodes.label: Config service (sources/server/Config.php)
nodes.rationale: Config keeps the default when a filter returns a value that is not valid.

nodes.label: Preview Dialog (one per page, wp_footer, singular view)
nodes.norm_label: preview dialog (one per page, wp_footer, singular view)

nodes.label: rinkukado-preview Script Module and Style Handle
nodes.norm_label: rinkukado-preview script module and style handle

nodes.label: Interactivity Config (wp_interactivity_config)
nodes.rationale: It holds the values that do not change while the page is open. No directive reads them.

nodes.label: Interactivity State (wp_interactivity_state)
nodes.rationale: It holds the values that the directives read.

nodes.label: Strict Client Schemas (sources/client/preview/schemas.ts)
nodes.rationale: The schemas are strict. The client refuses an unknown key and the preview does not start, so the schema must change in the same commit.

nodes.label: Filter rinkukado.popover.container-selector
nodes.rationale: The default keeps the popover on the links of the prose, and leaves the date, the author and the navigation alone.

nodes.label: Rule: the REST library does not use the plugin
nodes.rationale: Another plugin can copy the directory. No test guards the rule, so each change must be examined against it.
nodes.norm_label: rule: the rest library does not use the plugin

nodes.label: Text Domain Coupling of ErrorCatch
nodes.rationale: The library lives inside the plugin, so the plugin owns the translation. A closure argument gives no benefit while the library has one consumer.

nodes.label: Middleware Order (first is outermost)
nodes.rationale: Add ErrorCatch first, so that it also catches an error of the other middlewares.

nodes.label: Goal: Rest becomes a standalone library
nodes.rationale: Another plugin can copy the directory and use it. The change is a refactor with no change of behavior.
nodes.norm_label: goal: rest becomes a standalone library

nodes.label: Dropped option: own namespace and directory
nodes.rationale: It needs a second PSR-4 entry and a change of the tool configuration. A later move is only a rename.
nodes.norm_label: dropped option: own namespace and directory

nodes.label: Dropped option: own Composer package
nodes.rationale: Same reason as the own namespace, with more setup.

nodes.label: Preview\Module
nodes.rationale: It owns the route and publishes Config, because the library must know nothing about the plugin.

nodes.label: Naming: no Preview prefix, import the library namespace
nodes.rationale: The namespace already names the preview. Each class imports the namespace of the library, so the short names do not collide.
nodes.norm_label: naming: no preview prefix, import the library namespace

nodes.label: Architecture Test (tests/unit/server/Rest/ArchTest.php, removed)
nodes.rationale: It was the guard of the library. The review removed it, because the move to an external library makes the coupling impossible.

nodes.label: PreviewEndpointTest (integration)
nodes.rationale: It proves that the endpoint still works through the new module.

nodes.label: Filter names rinkukado.rest.* stay
nodes.rationale: Sites can use them already.

nodes.label: Endpoint answers 404 for a bad url
nodes.rationale: The 404 text stays. The review expected 400.
nodes.norm_label: endpoint answers 404 for a bad url
